description: Renders a draft and returns the text version, the live audience_count, quota_after_send and warnings (empty subject, missing button, over quota, first campaign pending review). Free, read only, sends nothing. Always call this before campaign_schedule and tell the person the audience count, the quota it will use and every warning. Requires API key scope: draft.
